name: ButtonTimed
description: A button with a built-in countdown timer that displays remaining seconds (e.g. 'Undo (5s)') and automatically triggers a callback when the timer reaches zero. Extends the base Button component's visual styles.

notes: The countdown text is announced via aria-live='polite' on the timer region.
When the timer reaches zero, onTimeout is called automatically.
The button remains interactive during countdown — clicking it triggers onClick.
Disabled state prevents both interaction and countdown.

onTimeout.description: Called when the countdown reaches zero.

disabled.description: Disables the button and pauses the countdown.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the root element.

children.description: Button label content. Countdown text is appended automatically.

do: Use for undo actions, auto-dismiss confirmations, or timed operations.
Keep initialTime short (3-10 seconds) to avoid user frustration.
Provide clear label text so the user understands what will happen on timeout.
dont: Do not use for primary actions that require deliberate user confirmation.
Do not set initialTime to 0 or negative values.
Do not use for long countdowns — consider a ProgressBar instead.
